title: Eastern Chickpea Falafel Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian wrap filled with crispy falafel, creamy sauce, and crunchy veggies.

ingredients.name: middle eastern spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, mash chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add middle eastern spices and mix well.
Add falafel mix and mix until a thick paste forms.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread a tablespoon of tahini sauce on each pita bread.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few falafel patties on each pita, followed by a dollop of tahini sauce, some chopped cucumber, and a sprinkle of parsley.
